turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good morning. Please, have a seat. Before we start, can I confirm your IC number?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My IC is nine zero zero four one two zero eight six five four three.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Thank you, Puan Siti. What brings you in today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I've had a cough for three days now, and since yesterday my throat is really sore.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you had any fever?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes. Last night it was thirty-eight point two. This morning it feels a bit lower.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Are you coughing anything up?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Some white phlegm. But this morning I noticed a few streaks of blood in my phlegm, and that worried me.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Was it only streaks, or more than that?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only a few streaks, just once.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any pain in your chest when you breathe or cough?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, no pain there.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Can you swallow? Are you eating and drinking normally?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I can swallow. It just hurts when my throat is dry.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Do you smoke?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, never.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any other medical problems?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I'm usually healthy.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Alright, let me have a look. Your throat is a bit red, and your chest sounds clear.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I'll give you something for the fever and the sore throat. If you see blood in your phlegm again, or you feel worse, please come back straight away.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. Thank you, doctor.
